Theorem
[Truncated ruled-cylinder estimate] 1. 9.3.2\group thurston.ch09.endingSource: thurston:page-0250 If $C$ is the ruled cylinder between geodesics $\gamma _1,\gamma _2$, then for $r\ge 0$, \[ \Area (C-\mathcal N_r\gamma _1)\le e^{-r}\length (\gamma _1)+\length (\gamma _2). \]
Proof

\sketch The contribution of the ruled sides decays exponentially with distance from $\gamma _1$, while the opposite boundary contributes at most its length.

□
